in_marathi.name: Sharvikaarna
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Sharvi + Powerful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvikaarna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharvikaarna is derived from two Sanskrit words - Sharvi and Karna. Sharvi is a name of the goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, music, arts, wisdom, and learning. Karna means 'powerful'. Thus, Sharvikaarna means 'Goddess Sharvi, the Powerful'.
